note: Vectors computed directly from the shipped kernel. Covers both deadline_bounded_inclusion (XRPL) terminal branches, federated_bft (Stellar SCP) externalization, the empty-input default, and the alpenglow (Solana Votor) confirmation-policy profile added additively in place.

vectors.name: xrpl-final-success
vectors.description: XRPL: validated inclusion with a tes result, a final success.

rationale: The transaction is included in a validated ledger with a tes result, so it is a final success.

vectors.name: xrpl-final-failure-tec
vectors.description: XRPL: validated inclusion with a tec result, a terminal fee-consuming failure.

rationale: The transaction is included in a validated ledger with a tec result. This is a terminal, final failure: the fee was consumed, there is no other ledger effect, and it is not retryable as the same intent.
A counterparty asserted final_success while the evaluated outcome is final_failure_tec. The claim is overstated.

vectors.name: xrpl-final-never-included
vectors.description: XRPL: deadline passed, gap-free validated history attested, no inclusion found, provable absence.

rationale: The submission deadline (last_ledger_sequence) has passed, the caller attests gap-free validated history over the submission range, and no inclusion was found. Absence is proven.

vectors.name: xrpl-expired-unprovable
vectors.description: XRPL: deadline passed, history gap attested, no inclusion found, and a counterparty claim overstated, unprovable absence.

rationale: The submission deadline has passed and no inclusion was found, but the caller does not attest gap-free validated history over that range, so absence is not proven. The transaction could exist in the gap.
A counterparty asserted final_never_included while the evaluated outcome is expired_unprovable. The claim is overstated.

vectors.name: stellar-final-quorum-trusted
vectors.description: Stellar SCP: externalized, trusted quorum slice, issuer clawback disclosed.

rationale: The transaction is externalized, which is unconditional finality under SCP: there is no reorg path once externalized.
The caller attests the relied-upon quorum slice(s) are within its own trust configuration. Consensus finality does not remove quorum-slice topology risk, it is a separate, declared input.

Issuer-clawback is enabled on this asset. An externalized transfer can still be clawed back by the issuer: that is an asset-authority property, distinct from consensus finality, and is disclosed separately here.

vectors.name: empty-input-defaults
vectors.description: Empty policy parameters, exercises the finite gate and the deadline_bounded_inclusion default.

rationale: No recognised settlement_model was supplied, so deadline_bounded_inclusion was assumed. Supply settlement_model to remove this assumption.
The submission deadline has not yet passed (highest_validated_ledger has not reached last_ledger_sequence) and no validated inclusion has been found.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.

vectors.name: alpenglow-fast-finalized
vectors.description: Alpenglow: round-one notarize stake above the 80% fast-finalization threshold, with the observed epoch past the pinned activation; final in one round.

rationale: Round-one notarize stake of 84% meets the 80% fast-finalization threshold (SIMD-0326), which finalizes the block after one voting round.

The same round-one stake also exceeds the 82% stake of the strong optimistic confirmation defined by the Alpenglow migration (SIMD-0384), though strong optimistic confirmation additionally requires the following-slot block to carry those votes.
Under Alpenglow the Confirmed and Finalized commitment statuses are equivalent (Anza documentation): the block is permanently committed and cannot be rolled back.

vectors.name: alpenglow-fast-exact-80-overstated-claim
vectors.description: Alpenglow: notarize stake exactly at the 80% fast-finalization boundary finalizes, so a counterparty asserting notarized_pending is overstated.

rationale: Round-one notarize stake of 80% meets the 80% fast-finalization threshold (SIMD-0326), which finalizes the block after one voting round.
Under Alpenglow the Confirmed and Finalized commitment statuses are equivalent (Anza documentation): the block is permanently committed and cannot be rolled back.
A counterparty asserted notarized_pending while the evaluated outcome is final. The claim is overstated.

vectors.name: alpenglow-fast-strong-oc-and-default-cutoff
vectors.description: Alpenglow: notarize stake above the 82% strong optimistic confirmation stake with an invalid required_tier, exercising the model default cutoff.

rationale: Round-one notarize stake of 91% meets the 80% fast-finalization threshold (SIMD-0326), which finalizes the block after one voting round.

The same round-one stake also exceeds the 82% stake of the strong optimistic confirmation defined by the Alpenglow migration (SIMD-0384), though strong optimistic confirmation additionally requires the following-slot block to carry those votes.
Under Alpenglow the Confirmed and Finalized commitment statuses are equivalent (Anza documentation): the block is permanently committed and cannot be rolled back.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.

vectors.name: alpenglow-slow-finalized
vectors.description: Alpenglow: round-one notarize below the fast threshold but round-two finalize stake above 60%, final in two rounds.

rationale: Round-two finalize stake of 64% meets the 60% slow-finalization threshold (SIMD-0326), which finalizes the block after two voting rounds.
Under Alpenglow the Confirmed and Finalized commitment statuses are equivalent (Anza documentation): the block is permanently committed and cannot be rolled back.

vectors.name: alpenglow-slow-exact-60-slot-position
vectors.description: Alpenglow: finalize stake exactly at the 60% slow-finalization boundary, regime decided from observed_slot alone (epoch absent).

rationale: Round-two finalize stake of 60% meets the 60% slow-finalization threshold (SIMD-0326), which finalizes the block after two voting rounds.
Under Alpenglow the Confirmed and Finalized commitment statuses are equivalent (Anza documentation): the block is permanently committed and cannot be rolled back.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.

vectors.name: alpenglow-notarized-pending-overstated-claim
vectors.description: Alpenglow: notarize stake forms a 60% notarization certificate without reaching 80%, so the block is notarized but not final, and a final claim is overstated.

rationale: Notarize stake of 62% forms a notarization certificate (the 60% threshold of SIMD-0326) but is below the 80% fast-finalization threshold, so the block is notarized without being final; finality waits on a 60% round-two finalize certificate or a later 80% round-one notarize.
A counterparty asserted final while the evaluated outcome is notarized_pending. The claim is overstated.

vectors.name: alpenglow-slot-skipped
vectors.description: Alpenglow: skip stake above the 60% skip-certificate threshold with notarize below the notarization threshold; the slot is certified skipped.

rationale: Skip or skip-fallback stake of 66% meets the 60% skip-certificate threshold (SIMD-0326): the slot is certified skipped and no block is finalized in it.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.

vectors.name: alpenglow-pre-activation
vectors.description: Alpenglow: observed epoch below the pinned activation epoch, so the position classifies under TowerBFT regardless of the supplied vote facts.

rationale: The observed position precedes the pinned Alpenglow activation (epoch 1064, slot 459648000), so this position is classified under TowerBFT, whose consensus finality of about 12.8 seconds is probabilistic, not the Votor confirmation policy.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.

vectors.name: alpenglow-regime-assumed-no-facts
vectors.description: Alpenglow: no observed position and no vote facts, so the regime is assumed and the block is pending with both assumption flags and draft pinned.

rationale: No observed_epoch or observed_slot was supplied, so the classification assumes the live regime is Alpenglow, active since the pinned activation (epoch 1064, slot 459648000). Supply the observed position to remove this assumption.
No notarize_stake_pct, finalize_stake_pct or skip_stake_pct within 0..100 was supplied, so no Votor certificate can be evaluated. The block is pending confirmation.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.

vectors.name: alpenglow-pending-below-all-thresholds
vectors.description: Alpenglow: all three supplied stakes below their certificate thresholds, so no certificate forms and the block is pending without the missing-facts flag.

rationale: The supplied vote facts form no Votor certificate: notarize stake 58% (below the 60% notarization threshold), finalize stake 55% (below the 60% slow-finalization threshold), skip stake 59% (below the 60% skip-certificate threshold). The block is pending confirmation.
No required_tier valid for this model was supplied, so the model default cutoff was applied.
